arStrings.szText: Casting {c_important}Hellion Sting{/c} within {c_number}[{SF_13}|1|]{/c} seconds of the last will increase the number of strikes, up to {c_number}{SF_14}{/c} total hits per cast.
{c_important}Hellion Sting{/c} launches a wave of spikes forward a long distance dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_SPIKE}{/c} damage per hit.

{c_important}Hellion Sting{/c} becomes a {c_important}Hellfire{/c} Skill and its {c_number}4th{/c} attack transforms you into {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c}, cleaving a wide area for {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_SWIPE}{/c} damage.
{c_important}Hellion Sting{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_23}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage to enemies for {c_number}{SF_24}{/c} seconds after you first strike them with it.
Casting {c_important}Hellion Sting{/c} increases your Wrath Regeneration by {c_number}[{SF_25}*100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_26}{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[{SF_25}*{SF_27}*100|%|]{/c}.
{c_important}Hellion Sting{/c} has {c_number}[{SF_28}|x%|]{/c} increased {c_important}{u}Eviscerate{/u}{/c} chance against your primary target.

When you strike an {c_important}{u}Eviscerated{/u}{/c} enemy with {c_important}Hellion Sting{/c} you are {c_important}{u}Fortified{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[{SF_30}*100|%|]{/c} Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_30]){/c}.
